description: The input attacks a mainstream value norm the agent holds as a baseline. This is the single exemption from the extraction rule, and it is deliberately not called dissonance: volition_self is zero by construction, so the volition gate would cap the index at 0.40 forever, and the direction is fully determinate, so indeterminacy is wrong too. The event travels the third channel, whose severity is the raw opposition rather than the index.
